86template <typename T, int d, typename FConcrete>
87void GeometryParticleDefaultConstruct(FConcrete& Concrete, const FGeometryParticleParameters& Params)
88{
89 Concrete.SetX(TVector<T, d>(0));
90 Concrete.SetR(TRotation<T, d>::Identity);
91 Concrete.SetSpatialIdx(FSpatialAccelerationIdx{ 0,0 });
92 Concrete.SetResimType(EResimType::FrozenDuringResim);
93 Concrete.SetEnabledDuringResim(true);
94}

98template <typename T, int d, typename FConcrete>
99void KinematicGeometryParticleDefaultConstruct(FConcrete& Concrete, const FKinematicGeometryParticleParameters& Params)
100{
101 Concrete.SetV(TVector<T, d>(0));
102 Concrete.SetW(TVector<T, d>(0));
103 if (AccelerationStructureSplitStaticAndDynamic == 1)
104 {
105 Concrete.SetSpatialIdx(FSpatialAccelerationIdx{ 0,1 });
106 }
107 else
108 {
109 Concrete.SetSpatialIdx(FSpatialAccelerationIdx{ 0,0 });
110 }
111}
112template <typename T, int d, typename FConcrete>
113void PBDRigidParticleDefaultConstruct(FConcrete& Concrete, const FPBDRigidParticleParameters& Params)
114{
115 //don't bother calling parent since the call gets made by the corresponding hierarchy in FConcrete
116 Concrete.SetCollisionGroup(0);
117 Concrete.SetLinearImpulseVelocity(TVector<T, d>(0));
118 Concrete.SetAngularImpulseVelocity(TVector<T, d>(0));
119 Concrete.SetMaxLinearSpeedSq(TNumericLimits<float>::Max());
120 Concrete.SetMaxAngularSpeedSq(TNumericLimits<float>::Max());
121 Concrete.SetInitialOverlapDepenetrationVelocity(-1.0f);
122 Concrete.SetSleepThresholdMultiplier(1.0f);
123 Concrete.SetM(1);
124 Concrete.SetInvM(1);
125 Concrete.SetCenterOfMass(TVector<T,d>(0));
126 Concrete.SetRotationOfMass(TRotation<T, d>::FromIdentity());
127 Concrete.SetI(TVec3<FRealSingle>(1, 1, 1));
128 Concrete.SetInvI(TVec3<FRealSingle>(1, 1, 1));
129 Concrete.SetLinearEtherDrag(0.f);
130 Concrete.SetAngularEtherDrag(0.f);
131 Concrete.SetGravityEnabled(Params.bGravityEnabled);
132 Concrete.SetGravityGroupIndex(0);
133 Concrete.SetCCDEnabled(Params.bCCDEnabled);
134 Concrete.SetMACDEnabled(false);
135 Concrete.SetPartialIslandSleepAllowed(true);
136 Concrete.SetIterationSettings(Private::FIterationSettings(INDEX_NONE, INDEX_NONE, INDEX_NONE));
137 Concrete.SetDisabled(Params.bDisabled);
138 Concrete.SetSleepType(ESleepType::MaterialSleep);
139}

162//Used to filter out at the acceleration structure layer using Query data
163//Returns true when there is no way a later PreFilter will succeed. Avoid virtuals etc..
164UE_DEPRECATED(5.8, "Use FShapeUnionFilterData::BroadFilter(const FQueryFilterData&) instead")
165FORCEINLINE_DEBUGGABLE bool PrePreQueryFilterImp(const FCollisionFilterData& QueryFilterData, const FCollisionFilterData& UnionFilterData)
166{
167 //HACK: need to replace all these hard-coded values with proper enums, bad modules are not setup for it right now
168 //ECollisionQuery QueryType = (ECollisionQuery)QueryFilter.Word0;
169 //if (QueryType != ECollisionQuery::ObjectQuery)
170 if(QueryFilterData.Word0)
171 {
172 //since we're taking the union of shapes we can only support trace channel
173 //const ECollisionChannel QuerierChannel = GetCollisionChannel(QueryFilter.Word3);
174 const uint32 QuerierChannel = (QueryFilterData.Word3 << 6) >> (32 - 5);
175
176 //uint32 const QuerierBit = ECC_TO_BITFIELD(QuerierChannel);
177 const uint32 QuerierBit = (1 << (QuerierChannel));
178
179 // check if Querier wants a hit
180 const uint32 TouchOrBlock = (UnionFilterData.Word1 | UnionFilterData.Word2);
181 return !(QuerierBit & TouchOrBlock);
182 }
183
184 return false;
185}
186
187UE_DEPRECATED(5.8, "Use the member functions on FShapeFilterData instead")
188FORCEINLINE_DEBUGGABLE uint32 GetChaosCollisionChannelAndExtraFilter(uint32 Word3, uint8& OutMaskFilter)
189{
190 uint32 ChannelMask = (Word3 << ChaosNumExtraFilterBits) >> (32 - ChaosNumCollisionChannelBits);
191 OutMaskFilter = Word3 >> (32 - ChaosNumExtraFilterBits);
192 return (uint32)ChannelMask;
193}
194
195//Used to filter out at the acceleration structure layer using Simdata
196//Returns true when there is no way a later PreFilter will succeed. Avoid virtuals etc..
197UE_DEPRECATED(5.8, "Use FShapeUnionFilterData::BroadFilter(const FShapeFilterData&) instead")
198FORCEINLINE_DEBUGGABLE bool PrePreSimFilterImp(const FCollisionFilterData& SimFilterData, const FCollisionFilterData& OtherSimFilterData)
199{
200 //HACK: need to replace all these hard-coded values with proper enums, bad modules are not setup for it right now
201 //since we're taking the union of shapes we can only support trace channel
202 //const ECollisionChannel QuerierChannel = GetCollisionChannel(QueryFilter.Word3);
203 PRAGMA_DISABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
204 uint8 QuerierMaskFilter;
205 const uint32 QuerierChannel = GetChaosCollisionChannelAndExtraFilter(SimFilterData.Word3, QuerierMaskFilter);
206 uint8 OtherMaskFilter;
207 const uint32 OtherChannel = GetChaosCollisionChannelAndExtraFilter(OtherSimFilterData.Word3, OtherMaskFilter);
208 PRAGMA_ENABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
209
210 //uint32 const QuerierBit = ECC_TO_BITFIELD(QuerierChannel);
211 const uint32 QuerierBit = (1 << (QuerierChannel));
212 const uint32 OtherBit = (1 << (OtherChannel));
213
214 // check if they can collide ( same logic as DoCollide in CollisionResolution.cpp )
215 const bool CanCollide = (QuerierBit & OtherSimFilterData.Word1) && (OtherBit & SimFilterData.Word1);
216 return !CanCollide;
217}

256 UE_DEPRECATED(5.8, "This has been deprecated in favor of PrePreFilter")
257 bool PrePreQueryFilter(const void* QueryData) const
258 {
259 if(bCanPrePreFilter)
260 {
261 if (const FCollisionFilterData* QueryFilterData = static_cast<const FCollisionFilterData*>(QueryData))
262 {
263 PRAGMA_DISABLE_INTERNAL_WARNINGS
264 const Chaos::Filter::FQueryFilterData QuerierFilter = Chaos::Filter::FQueryFilterBuilder::BuildFromLegacyQueryFilter(*QueryFilterData);
265 PRAGMA_ENABLE_INTERNAL_WARNINGS
266 return UnionFilter.BroadFilter(QuerierFilter) == Chaos::Filter::EBroadFilterResult::Reject;
267 }
268 }
269
270 return false;
271 }
272
273 UE_DEPRECATED(5.8, "This has been deprecated in favor of PrePreFilter")
274 bool PrePreSimFilter(const void* SimData) const
275 {
276 if (bCanPrePreFilter)
277 {
278 if (const FCollisionFilterData* SimFilterData = static_cast<const FCollisionFilterData*>(SimData))
279 {
280 PRAGMA_DISABLE_INTERNAL_WARNINGS
281 const Chaos::Filter::FShapeFilterData ShapeFilter = Chaos::Filter::FShapeFilterBuilder::BuildFromLegacySimFilter(*SimFilterData);
282 PRAGMA_ENABLE_INTERNAL_WARNINGS
283 Chaos::Filter::FShapeUnionFilterData SimUnionFilter;
284 SimUnionFilter.Combine(ShapeFilter);
285 return UnionFilter.BroadFilter(SimUnionFilter) == Chaos::Filter::EBroadFilterResult::Reject;
286 }
287 }
288
289 return false;
290 }

297 }
298
299 return false;

356template <typename T, int d>
357class TParticleHandleBase
358{
359public:
360 using TType = T;
361 static constexpr int D = d;
362
363 TParticleHandleBase()
364 : SerializableGeometryParticles(TSerializablePtr<TGeometryParticles<T,d>>())
365 , ParticleIdx(0)
366 , Type(EParticleType::Static)
367 {
368 }
369
370 template <typename TParticlesType>
371 TParticleHandleBase(TSerializablePtr<TParticlesType> InParticles, int32 InParticleIdx)
372 : SerializableGeometryParticles(InParticles)
373 , ParticleIdx(InParticleIdx)
374 , Type(InParticles ? InParticles->ParticleType() : EParticleType::Static)
375 {
376 }
377
378 //Should only be used for transient handles - maybe we can protect this better?
379 TParticleHandleBase(TGeometryParticles<T,d>* InParticles, int32 InParticleIdx)
380 : SerializableGeometryParticles(TSerializablePtr<TGeometryParticles<T, d>>())
381 , ParticleIdx(InParticleIdx)
382 , Type(InParticles ? InParticles->ParticleType() : EParticleType::Static)
383 {
384 GeometryParticles = InParticles;
385 }
386
387 //NOTE: this is not virtual and only acceptable because we know the children have no extra data that requires destruction.
388 //You must modify the union to extend this class and do not add any member variables
389 ~TParticleHandleBase() = default;
390
391 void Serialize(FChaosArchive& Ar)
392 {
393 Ar << ParticleIdx;
394 uint8 RawType = (uint8)Type;
395 Ar << RawType;
396 Type = (EParticleType)RawType;
397 Ar << SerializableGeometryParticles;
398 }
399
400 //This is needed for post serialization fixup of raw pointer. Should only be called by serialization code which is low level and knows the implementation details
401 void SetSOALowLevel(TGeometryParticles<T, d>* InParticles)
402 {
403 //should not be swapping SOAs
404 ensure(GeometryParticles == nullptr || GeometryParticles == InParticles);
405 GeometryParticles = InParticles;
406 }
407
408 EParticleType GetParticleType() const { return Type; }
409protected:
410 union
411 {
412 TSerializablePtr<TGeometryParticles<T, d>> SerializableGeometryParticles;
413 TGeometryParticles<T, d>* GeometryParticles;
414 TKinematicGeometryParticles<T, d>* KinematicGeometryParticles;
415 TPBDRigidParticles<T, d>* PBDRigidParticles;
416 TPBDRigidClusteredParticles<T, d>* PBDRigidClusteredParticles;
417 };
418
419 template <typename TSOA>
420 friend class TConstParticleIterator;
421 //todo: maybe make private?
422 int32 ParticleIdx; //Index into the particle struct of arrays. Note the index can change
423 EParticleType Type;
424};

495 template <typename TParticlesType, typename TParams>
496 static TUniquePtr<typename TParticlesType::THandleType> CreateParticleHandleHelper(TSerializablePtr<TParticlesType> InParticles, int32 InParticleIdx, int32 InHandleIdx, const TParams& Params)
497 {
498 check(bPersistent); //non persistent should not be going through this path
499 auto NewHandle = new typename TParticlesType::THandleType(InParticles, InParticleIdx, InHandleIdx, Params);
500 TUniquePtr<typename TParticlesType::THandleType> Unique(NewHandle);
501 const_cast<TParticlesType*>(InParticles.Get())->SetHandle(InParticleIdx, NewHandle); //todo: add non const serializable ptr
502 return Unique;
503 }
504public:
505
506 static TUniquePtr<TGeometryParticleHandleImp<T,d, bPersistent>> CreateParticleHandle(TSerializablePtr<TGeometryParticles<T, d>> InParticles, int32 InParticleIdx, int32 InHandleIdx, const FGeometryParticleParameters& Params = FGeometryParticleParameters())
507 {
508 return TGeometryParticleHandleImp<T,d,bPersistent>::CreateParticleHandleHelper(InParticles, InParticleIdx, InHandleIdx, Params);
509 }
510
511 ~TGeometryParticleHandleImp()
512 {
513 if constexpr (bPersistent)
514 {
515 // If we weren't removed from the graph, invalid pointer dereferencing is possible
516 check(GetConstraintGraphNode() == nullptr);
517
518 GeometryParticles->ResetWeakParticleHandle(ParticleIdx);
519 GeometryParticles->DestroyParticle(ParticleIdx);
520 if (static_cast<uint32>(ParticleIdx) < GeometryParticles->Size())
521 {
522 if (GeometryParticles->RemoveParticleBehavior() == ERemoveParticleBehavior::RemoveAtSwap)
523 {
524 GeometryParticles->Handle(ParticleIdx)->ParticleIdx = ParticleIdx;
525 }
526 else
527 {
528 //need to update all handles >= ParticleIdx
529 for (int32 Idx = ParticleIdx; static_cast<uint32>(Idx) < GeometryParticles->Size(); ++Idx)
530 {
531 GeometryParticles->Handle(Idx)->ParticleIdx -= 1;
532 }
533 }
534 }
535
536 // Zero the handle out to detect dangling handles and associated memory corruptions
537 HandleIdx = INDEX_NONE;
538 GeometryParticles = nullptr;
539 ParticleIdx = INDEX_NONE;
540 Type = EParticleType::Unknown;
541
542 CVD_TRACE_INVALIDATE_CACHED_PARTICLE_METADATA(this);
543 }
544 }

777#if CHAOS_DETERMINISTIC
778 FParticleID ParticleID() const { return GeometryParticles->ParticleID(ParticleIdx); }
779 void SetParticleID(const FParticleID& ParticleID)
780 {
781 //When particles are created they are assigned a unique local index
782 //This index cannot be used for replicated particles (which use a global index)
783 //The global index (if used) is set on the game thread and comes over in the NonFrequent data
784 //However, it's possible that the particle id was never set (not used), so it will come over as -1,-1
785 //In this case we should continue to use the local index
786
787 //TODO: find a better way to deal with this, shouldn't be at such a low level API
788
789 if (ParticleID.GlobalID != INDEX_NONE || ParticleID.LocalID != INDEX_NONE)
790 {
791 GeometryParticles->ParticleID(ParticleIdx) = ParticleID;
792 }
793 }
794#endif
795
796 void MoveToSOA(TGeometryParticles<T, d>& ToSOA)
797 {
798 static_assert(bPersistent, "Cannot move particles from a transient handle");
799 check(ToSOA.ParticleType() == Type);
800 if (GeometryParticles != &ToSOA)
801 {
802 GeometryParticles->MoveToOtherParticles(ParticleIdx, ToSOA);
803 if (static_cast<uint32>(ParticleIdx) < GeometryParticles->Size())
804 {
805 GeometryParticles->Handle(ParticleIdx)->ParticleIdx = ParticleIdx;
806 }
807
808 const int32 NewParticleIdx = ToSOA.Size() - 1;
809 ParticleIdx = NewParticleIdx;
810
811 // Update the particles' list mask to match its new container
812 check(GeometryParticles->GetContainerListMask() != EGeometryParticleListMask::None);
813 check(ToSOA.GetContainerListMask() != EGeometryParticleListMask::None);
814 ToSOA.ListMask(ParticleIdx) &= ~GeometryParticles->GetContainerListMask();
815 ToSOA.ListMask(ParticleIdx) |= ToSOA.GetContainerListMask();
816
817 GeometryParticles = &ToSOA;
818 }
819 }

1503void TGeometryParticleHandleImp<T,d,bPersistent>::SetXR(const FParticlePositionRotation& XR)

1510 Rigid->SetQf(GetRf());

1514template <typename T, int d, bool bPersistent>

1516{
1517public:
1518 using TGeometryParticleHandleImp<T, d, bPersistent>::ParticleIdx;
1519 using TGeometryParticleHandleImp<T, d, bPersistent>::PBDRigidClusteredParticles;

1523
1524protected:

1526 //needed for serialization
1527 TPBDRigidClusteredParticleHandleImp<T, d, bPersistent>()
1528 : TPBDRigidParticleHandleImp<T, d, bPersistent>()
1529 {

1533 : TPBDRigidParticleHandleImp<T, d, bPersistent>(TSerializablePtr<TPBDRigidParticles<T, d>>(Particles), InIdx, InGlobalIdx, Params)

1752template <typename T, int d, bool bPersistent>
1753FString TGeometryParticleHandleImp<T, d, bPersistent>::ToString() const
1754{
1755 switch (Type)
1756 {
1757 case EParticleType::Static:
1758 return FString::Printf(TEXT("Static[%d]"), ParticleIdx);
1759 case EParticleType::Kinematic:
1760 return FString::Printf(TEXT("Kinemmatic[%d]"), ParticleIdx);
1761 case EParticleType::Rigid:
1762 return FString::Printf(TEXT("Dynamic[%d]"), ParticleIdx);
1763 case EParticleType::GeometryCollection:
1764 return FString::Printf(TEXT("GeometryCollection[%d]"), ParticleIdx);
1765 case EParticleType::Clustered:
1766 return FString::Printf(TEXT("Clustered[%d]"), ParticleIdx);
1767 default:
1768 break;
1769 }
1770 return FString();
1771}

1777 static_assert(sizeof(TGeometryParticleHandleImp<T, d, bPersistent>) == sizeof(TGeometryParticleHandleImp<T, d, bPersistent>), "No new members in derived classes");
1778 return Ar.IsLoading() ? new TGeometryParticleHandleImp<T, d, bPersistent>() : nullptr;
1779}

2677template <typename T, int d>
2678class TGeometryParticleHandles : public TArrayCollection
2679{
2680public:
2681 TGeometryParticleHandles()
2682 {
2683 AddArray(&Handles);
2684 }
2685
2686 void AddHandles(int32 NumHandles)
2687 {
2688 AddElementsHelper(NumHandles);
2689 }
2690
2691 void Reset()
2692 {
2693 ResizeHelper(0);
2694 }
2695
2696 void DestroyHandleSwap(TGeometryParticleHandle<T,d>* Handle)
2697 {
2698 const int32 UnstableIdx = Handle->HandleIdx;
2699
2700#if UE_DEBUG_DANGLING_HANDLES
2701 // This helps to detect dangling handles and associated memory corruptions
2702 // Leaking memory deliberately here, so only use this while debugging
2703 Handles[UnstableIdx]->~TGeometryParticleHandleImp();
2704 (void)Handles[UnstableIdx].Release();
2705#endif
2706
2707 RemoveAtSwapHelper(UnstableIdx);
2708 if (static_cast<uint32>(UnstableIdx) < Size())
2709 {
2710 Handles[UnstableIdx]->HandleIdx = UnstableIdx;
2711 }
2712 }
2713
2714 void Serialize(FChaosArchive& Ar)
2715 {
2716 Ar << Handles;
2717 ResizeHelper(Handles.Num());
2718 }
2719
2720 const TUniquePtr<TGeometryParticleHandle<T, d>>& Handle(int32 Idx) const { return Handles[Idx];}
2721 TUniquePtr<TGeometryParticleHandle<T, d>>& Handle(int32 Idx) { return Handles[Idx]; }
2722private:
2723 TArrayCollectionArray<TUniquePtr<TGeometryParticleHandleImp<T, d, true>>> Handles;
2724};

2989 void SetShapeInstances(FShapeInstanceProxyArray&& InShapes)
2990 {
2991 // This is only called after setting or merging geometry which resizes the shapes array
2992 // so we should always have enough elements at this point
2993 check(InShapes.Num() == MShapesArray.Num());

2997 // Overwite the last N shapes with the data from InShapes. This is a highly dubious operation
2998 // provided as a utility for use in FPhysInterface_Chaos::AddGeometry. Ideally we would remove this
2999 void MergeShapeInstances(FShapeInstanceProxyArray&& InShapes)
3000 {
3001 check(InShapes.Num() <= (MShapesArray.Num()));
3002 int Idx = MShapesArray.Num() - InShapes.Num();
3003 for (FShapeInstanceProxyPtr& Shape : InShapes)
3004 {
3005 ensure(Idx < MShapesArray.Num());
3006 Shape->ModifyShapeIndex(Idx);
3007 MShapesArray[Idx++] = MoveTemp(Shape);
3008 }
3009 }

3161 // Pointer to any data that the solver wants to associate with this particle

3164 class IPhysicsProxyBase* Proxy;
3165
3166 /*
3167 * Describes how a call to ModifyGeometry wishes to access the underlying particle geometry
3168 */
3169 enum class EGeometryAccess
3170 {
3171 // Grant direct access to the geometry, use with care - if the geometry is in
3172 // use inside a solver this will likely be unsafe. If the geometry is not
3173 // in use, all calls to ModifyGeometry will use Direct
3174 Direct,
3175
3176 // Create a new root union, but shallow copy all geometries within the union.
3177 // This is fine if you are only removing shapes, or adding shapes. If you require
3178 // the ability to modify the actual geometry you must take a deep copy.
3179 ShallowCopy,
3180
3181 // Create a new root union and deep copy all geometries within it. This is required
3182 // if you intend to actually modify the geometry itself and not just grow/shrink
3183 // the number of shapes on the particle
3184 DeepCopy
3185 };
3186
3187 template <typename Lambda>
3188 void ModifyGeometry(const Lambda& Func, const bool bDirectAccess = false)
3189 {
3190 return ModifyGeometry(bDirectAccess ? EGeometryAccess::Direct : EGeometryAccess::DeepCopy, Func);
3191 }
3192
3193 template <typename Lambda>
3194 void ModifyGeometry(EGeometryAccess AccessType, const Lambda& Func)
3195 {
3196 ensure(Chaos::CVars::bEnableAsyncInitBody || IsInGameThread());
3197 FPhysicsSolverBase* Solver = Proxy ? Proxy->GetSolverBase() : nullptr;
3198
3199 if(Solver == nullptr)
3200 {
3201 //not registered yet so we can still modify geometry safely
3202 AccessType = EGeometryAccess::Direct;
3203 }
3204 else if(AccessType == EGeometryAccess::ShallowCopy && CVars::ForceDeepCopyOnModifyGeometry())
3205 {
3206 AccessType = EGeometryAccess::DeepCopy;
3207 }
3208
3209 MNonFrequentData.Modify(true, MDirtyFlags, Proxy, [this, Solver, &Func, AccessType](auto& Data)
3210 {
3211 FImplicitObjectPtr GeomToModify = nullptr;
3212 bool bNewGeom = false;
3213 if(Data.GetGeometry())
3214 {
3215 switch(AccessType)
3216 {
3217 case EGeometryAccess::Direct:
3218 GeomToModify = Data.AccessGeometryDangerous();
3219 break;
3220 case EGeometryAccess::ShallowCopy:
3221 GeomToModify = Data.GetGeometry()->CopyGeometry();
3222 bNewGeom = true;
3223 break;
3224 case EGeometryAccess::DeepCopy:
3225 GeomToModify = Data.GetGeometry()->DeepCopyGeometry();
3226 bNewGeom = true;
3227 break;
3228 default:
3229 check(false);
3230 break;
3231 }
3232
3233 Func(*GeomToModify);
3234
3235 if(bNewGeom)
3236 {
3237 //must set geometry after because shapes are rebuilt and we want them to know about anything Func did
3238 Data.SetGeometry(GeomToModify);
3239 }
3240 else
3241 {
3242 // Only invalidate the geometry if we modified the existing one.
3243 // New geometry will be always evaluated the first time it is seen
3244 CVD_TRACE_INVALIDATE_CACHED_GEOMETRY(GeomToModify);
3245 }
3246 UpdateShapesArray();
3247 }
3248 });
3249 }

3286// Update all the shapes datas including the convexes ones
3287template<typename ParticleType>
3288void UpdateParticleShapes(const TArray<ParticleType*>& ShapesParticles, const FImplicitObject* ImplicitObject,
3289 const FShapesArray& ShapesArray, const int32 ActorId, const int32 ComponentID)
3290{
3291 if (!ShapesParticles.IsEmpty() && (ShapesParticles.Num() <= (ShapesArray.Num())))
3292 {
3293 for (int32 ParticleIndex = 0; ParticleIndex < ShapesParticles.Num(); ++ParticleIndex)
3294 {
3295 const TUniquePtr<Chaos::FPerShapeData>& ShapeData = ShapesArray[ParticleIndex];
3296 const TUniquePtr<Chaos::FPerShapeData>& TemplateShape = ShapesParticles[ParticleIndex]->ShapesArray()[0];
3297
3298 if (ShapeData && TemplateShape)
3299 {
3300 {
3301 FCollisionData Data = TemplateShape->GetCollisionData();
3302 Data.UserData = nullptr;
3303 ShapeData->SetCollisionData(Data);
3304 }
3305
3306 {
3307 const Chaos::Filter::FInstanceData InstanceData(ActorId, ComponentID);
3308 ShapeData->SetFilterInstanceData(InstanceData);
3309 ShapeData->SetShapeFilterData(TemplateShape->GetShapeFilterData());
3310 }
3311
3312 ShapeData->SetSimEnabled(TemplateShape->GetSimEnabled());
3313 ShapeData->SetQueryEnabled(TemplateShape->GetQueryEnabled());
3314 }
3315 }
3316 }
3317}

3739 EObjectStateType ObjectState() const { return MMiscData.Read().ObjectState(); }
3740 void SetObjectState(const EObjectStateType InState, bool bAllowEvents=false, bool bInvalidate=true)
3741 {
3742 if (bAllowEvents)
3743 {
3744 const auto PreState = ObjectState();
3745 if(PreState == EObjectStateType::Dynamic && InState == EObjectStateType::Sleeping)
3746 {
3747 MWakeEvent = EWakeEventEntry::Sleep;
3748 }
3749 else if(PreState == EObjectStateType::Sleeping && InState == EObjectStateType::Dynamic)
3750 {
3751 MWakeEvent = EWakeEventEntry::Awake;
3752 }
3753 }
3754
3755 if (InState == EObjectStateType::Sleeping)
3756 {
3757 // When an object is forced into a sleep state, the velocities must be zeroed and buffered,
3758 // in case the velocity is queried during sleep, or in case the object is woken up again.
3759 this->SetV(FVec3(0.f), bInvalidate);
3760 this->SetW(FVec3(0.f), bInvalidate);
3761
3762 // Dynamic particle properties must be marked clean in order not to actually apply forces which
3763 // have been buffered. If another force is added after the object is put to sleep, the old forces
3764 // will remain and the new ones will accumulate and re-dirty the dynamic properties which will
3765 // wake the body.
3766 MDirtyFlags.MarkClean(ChaosPropertyToFlag(EChaosProperty::Dynamics));
3767 }
3768
3769 MMiscData.Modify(bInvalidate,MDirtyFlags,Proxy,[&InState](auto& Data){ Data.SetObjectState(InState);});
3770
3771 }
3772
3773 void SetSleepType(ESleepType SleepType, bool bAllowEvents=false, bool bInvalidate=true)
3774 {
3775 MMiscData.Modify(true,MDirtyFlags,Proxy,[SleepType](auto& Data){ Data.SetSleepType(SleepType);});
3776
3777 if (SleepType == ESleepType::NeverSleep && ObjectState() == EObjectStateType::Sleeping)
3778 {
3779 SetObjectState(EObjectStateType::Dynamic, bAllowEvents, bInvalidate);
3780 }
3781 }

3936template <typename T, int d>
3937TGeometryParticle<T, d>* TGeometryParticle<T, d>::SerializationFactory(FChaosArchive& Ar, TGeometryParticle<T, d>* Serializable)
3938{
3939 int8 ObjectType = Ar.IsLoading() ? 0 : (int8)Serializable->Type;
3940 Ar << ObjectType;
3941 switch ((EParticleType)ObjectType)
3942 {
3943 case EParticleType::Static: if (Ar.IsLoading()) { return new TGeometryParticle<T, d>(); } break;
3944 case EParticleType::Kinematic: if (Ar.IsLoading()) { return new TKinematicGeometryParticle<T, d>(); } break;
3945 case EParticleType::Rigid: if (Ar.IsLoading()) { return new TPBDRigidParticle<T, d>(); } break;
3946 case EParticleType::GeometryCollection: if (Ar.IsLoading()) { return new TPBDGeometryCollectionParticle<T, d>(); } break;
3947 default:
3948 check(false);
3949 }
3950 return nullptr;
3951}

3997template <typename TParticle>
3998/* static */ void FAccelerationStructureHandle::ComputeParticleQueryFilterDataFromShapes(const TParticle& Particle, FCollisionFilterData& OutQueryFilterData)
3999{
4000 const auto& Shapes = Particle.ShapesArray();
4001 for (const auto& Shape : Shapes)
4002 {
4003 // For queries we can ignore any shapes that are not query-enabled (e.g., sim- and probe-only)
4004 if (Shape->GetQueryEnabled())
4005 {
4006 PRAGMA_DISABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
4007 const FCollisionFilterData& ShapeQueryData = Shape->GetQueryData();
4008 PRAGMA_ENABLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
4009 OutQueryFilterData.Word0 |= ShapeQueryData.Word0;
4010 OutQueryFilterData.Word1 |= ShapeQueryData.Word1;
4011 OutQueryFilterData.Word2 |= ShapeQueryData.Word2;
4012 OutQueryFilterData.Word3 |= ShapeQueryData.Word3;
4013 }
4014 }
4015}
4016
4017template <typename TParticle>
4018/* static */ void FAccelerationStructureHandle::ComputeFilterDataFromShapes(const TParticle& Particle, Chaos::Filter::FShapeUnionFilterData& OutFilter)
4019{
4020 const FShapesArray& Shapes = Particle.ShapesArray();
4021 OutFilter = Chaos::Filter::FShapeUnionFilterData();
4022 for (const auto& Shape : Shapes)
4023 {
4024 const bool bSimEnabled = Shape->GetSimEnabled() || Shape->GetIsProbe();
4025 const bool bQueryEnabled = Shape->GetQueryEnabled();
4026 OutFilter.Combine(Shape->GetShapeFilterData(), bQueryEnabled, bSimEnabled);
4027 }
4028}
4029
4030template <typename TParticle>
4031FORCEINLINE_DEBUGGABLE void FAccelerationStructureHandle::UpdatePrePreFilter(const TParticle& Particle)
4032{
4033 ComputeFilterDataFromShapes(Particle, UnionFilter);
4034 bCanPrePreFilter = true;
4035}

4038FORCEINLINE_DEBUGGABLE void FAccelerationStructureHandle::Serialize(FChaosArchive& Ar)
4039{
4040 Ar << AsAlwaysSerializable(ExternalGeometryParticle);
4041 Ar << AsAlwaysSerializable(GeometryParticleHandle);
4042
4043 Ar.UsingCustomVersion(FExternalPhysicsCustomObjectVersion::GUID);
4044 if (Ar.CustomVer(FExternalPhysicsCustomObjectVersion::GUID) >= FExternalPhysicsCustomObjectVersion::SerializeHashResult && Ar.CustomVer(FExternalPhysicsCustomObjectVersion::GUID) < FExternalPhysicsCustomObjectVersion::UniquePayloadIdx)
4045 {
4046 uint32 DummyHash;
4047 Ar << DummyHash;
4048 }
4049
4050 if(GeometryParticleHandle)
4051 {
4052 CachedUniqueIdx = GeometryParticleHandle->UniqueIdx();
4053 }
4054 else if(ExternalGeometryParticle)
4055 {
4056 CachedUniqueIdx = ExternalGeometryParticle->UniqueIdx();
4057 }
4058
4059 if (GeometryParticleHandle && ExternalGeometryParticle)
4060 {
4061 ensure(GeometryParticleHandle->UniqueIdx() == ExternalGeometryParticle->UniqueIdx());
4062 }
4063
4064 ensure(!GeometryParticleHandle || CachedUniqueIdx.IsValid());
4065 ensure(!ExternalGeometryParticle || CachedUniqueIdx.IsValid());
4066}
4067
4068FORCEINLINE_DEBUGGABLE FChaosArchive& operator<<(FChaosArchive& Ar, FAccelerationStructureHandle& AccelerationHandle)
4069{
4070 AccelerationHandle.Serialize(Ar);
4071 return Ar;
4072}

4075FORCEINLINE_DEBUGGABLE void FAccelerationStructureHandle::DebugDraw(const bool bExternal, const bool bHit) const
4076{
